meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行管好代码工作树和终端,把任务交接给下一个智能体继续做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时开多个代码分支并行干活,还要在智能体之间来回交接任务
copy.tagline_en: Manage worktrees and terminals from the command line, hand tasks off to another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run parallel branches and pass tasks between agents

howto.what: Claude 会先按当前会话环境选对 orca 可执行文件,再加载与版本匹配的指南,然后用 orca CLI 操作 Orca 的工作树、终端、仓库、工件等;指南没覆盖的命令改用 --help 查询。
howto.when: 当你提到 “$orca-cli”“Orca worktree” 等关键词,或要把任务交接给另一个 agent 时触发;涉及 Orca 状态时优先于原生 git worktree 与 Computer Use。

say.text: 先加载 orca-cli 指南,再列出当前 Orca 工作树
say.note: 会先执行 ORCA skills get orca-cli

say.text: 在这个 Orca worktree 里起一个 claude 子工作树
say.note: 会创建子工作树并启动会话

say.text: 读出目标 Orca 终端的输出,再往里发送这条命令
say.note: 读取并写入指定的 Orca 终端

howto.what_en: Claude resolves the right orca executable for the session, loads the version-matched guide, then drives Orca worktrees, terminals, repos, artifacts and the embedded browser via the orca CLI; uncovered flags fall back to --help.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff" and the like, or hand work to another agent; when Orca state is involved it is preferred over raw git worktree and Computer Use.

say_en.text: Load the orca-cli guide, then list my current Orca worktrees
say_en.note: Runs ORCA skills get orca-cli first

say_en.text: Start a child worktree with claude in it
say_en.note: Creates a child worktree and starts the session

say_en.text: Read the Orca terminal output, then send this command to it
say_en.note: Reads and writes the selected Orca terminal
